prompts.prompt: In Veeam Backup and Replication version 12 and later, what TCP port does the unified REST API listen on by default? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/veeam/SKILL.md - REST API (v12+) Base URL: https://[vbr-server]:9419/api/v1

prompts.prompt: When enabling AWS S3 Object Lock on a bucket used as a Veeam immutable backup repository, which retention mode should you choose for true ransomware protection, Governance or Compliance? Answer in one sentence.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/veeam/SKILL.md - Choose Compliance mode (not Governance) for true ransomware protection

prompts.prompt: In Veeam SureBackup verification, what is the default timeout in seconds for the heartbeat test and the ping test? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/veeam/SKILL.md - Verification Tests table: Heartbeat test and Ping test default timeout 300 seconds
